messages:
Aisha CS: FYI — OrionCare (trial) flagged a partner integration demo for LATAM (Brazil) next Mon 14:00 BRT. They need a scoped sa-east-1 allowlist + small QPS bump and an ephemeral webhook burst allowance for file ingest calls. Renewal discussion depends on smooth demo. Can we support 30 qps sustained for 60 minutes with auto-revoke? Please advise.

Marco Ops: @Aisha share source IPs, endpoints and TTL. Webhook burst means inbound calls to our ingest endpoint or customer calling us?

Aisha CS: Org: orioncare-trial (ORC-303). Endpoints: /v1/infer-stream, /v1/embeddings, plus POST /v1/webhook/ingest for partner sync. IPs:

```
192.0.2.77/32
192.0.2.78/32
2001:db8:beef::/64
```

TTL: 2026-05-01T00:00Z. Webhook bursts expected < 300 concurrent short requests for ~15min within the 60m window.

Marco Ops: Opening CS ticket and tagging infra for webhook rate shaping. Will apply sa-east-1 edge allowlist. Creating ticket now...

ops-bot: Ticket #CS-4922 created: sa-east-1 allowlist + webhook burst exception + qps bump. https://redwood.ops/tickets/CS-4922 (assignee: Marco Ops)

Dani Eng: For infer-stream, recommend pin to `rwd-stream-1` and enable streaming chunk size limit. For webhooks, we'll add a short-lived burst bucket: burst_capacity=300, refill=5s. For hosted customers set soft_qps=35 hard_qps=50 to accommodate spikes. Also suggest enabling KV-prefix caching for embeddings.

Oliver SE: Approved by oncall. Ops please set soft_qps=35 hard_qps=50 and configure webhook burst bucket. Also set routepolicy to sa-east-1 with fallback to eu-west-1 if saturated.

Marco Ops: Done — allowlist applied to sa-east-1 edge, soft_qps=35 hard_qps=50, webhook_burst_capacity=300 refill=5s, auto_revoke=2026-05-01T00:00Z. Added session token cap for webhooks: 10000 tokens/window. Ticket CS-4922 updated.

ops-bot: CS-4922 updated: allowlist active, soft_qps=35, hard_qps=50, webhook_burst_capacity=300, auto_revoke=2026-05-01T00:00Z.

Aisha CS: Customer confirmed they can connect and partner ingestion succeeded in smoke test. I'll update renewal notes and schedule a post-demo check-in. Thanks team :sparkles:

Dani Eng: Added playbook snippet to ticket: demo with webhook bursts requires pre-approval + burst bucket + monitor webhook latency and error-rate. We also added alert: org=ORC-303 error_rate>1.5% or webhook_5xx>0.5%.

Marco Ops: Monitoring active, prewarm completed. I'll revoke at TTL automatically and follow up to close ticket after verification.

Aisha CS: Perfect — I'll record the renewal touchpoint. Good luck to OrionCare on demo! :four_leaf_clover:
